profile.headline: Groovy
profile.summary:
I am an uncommon effort multiplier using AI and 15+ years as an engineer to quickly move and prove concepts and ideas with a nimble touch.  

I am an evolving senior engineer & tech lead at home wearing many hats; doing many different dynamic and shifting tasks. From running teams to architecting enterprise level solutions; from serverless development to large throughput database design;  from developing lambdas to optimizing for fargate, I am elbows deep in technical solutions.

I am enthusiastic about the next steps and the course our industry is on.  Everything that rises must converge.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Expanding the virtual frontier by enabling AI and unlocking hard to win proof of concepts and analysis for clients and customers the world over.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Project Leadership · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Cloud Applications

positions.title: Team Lead | Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Leadership Achievements:
    • Led a cross-functional team of 8 engineers to implement vNext, an AI-driven SaaS platform backend that reduced customer onboarding time by 90% and achieved a 15% reduction in cloud costs
    • Led the data lakehouse architectural decision making team vetting top tier data storage providers like Snowflake, Databricks & AWS Redshift, running performance tests against billions of rows & implementing a solution with terabytes of data in multiple staged environments
    • Partnered with Product Management team to deliver next generation AI driven, customer products ensuring sprint goals and tasks hewed closely to company roadmap and timelines
    • Drove unified open telemetry solution for 6 high throughput distributed systems utilizing DataDog and Prometheus/Jaeger
    • Successfully managed vendor partnerships that tripled team velocity while maintaining code quality standards
    • Established architectural guidelines and best practices for multiple mission-critical services
Technical Achievements:
    • Engineered and implemented automated customer onboarding through use of AI, prompt engineering and custom algorithms to achieve 97% accuracy, reducing manual hours by more than 60%
    • Architected and implemented high-throughput, AI-driven services processing 100K+ transactions daily with 99.9% uptime using a variety of languages such as Python, NodeJS & Go
    • Built high volume, cloud-native data storage solutions on AWS utilizing S3, DynamoDB & RDS
    • Engineered containerized computer vision services on AWS ECS that analyzed and tagged millions of media assets, improving content discoverability by 70%
    • Designed and implemented front end UI code with security using SSO, OAuth and enterprise providers
    • Integrated Stripe payment system to effectively onboard new customers identifying account type, location (tax purposes) and recurring billing
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Project Leadership · Python (Programming Language) · Leading Development Teams · PL/SQL · TypeScript · React.js · Go (Programming Language) · DevOps · Computer Vision · Ffmpeg · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Software development engineer
positions.description:
• Orchestrated the code deliverables and data asset rollup for multi-million dollar SaaS application acquisition
    • Designed and implemented serverless backend architecture supporting high-volume enterprise applications
    • Mentored junior engineers, reducing their onboarding time by 40% and accelerating project delivery timelines
    • Developed scalable GraphQL APIs and middle-tier solutions using NodeJS that unified data access across multiple client applications
    • Created integration services connecting frontend frameworks (React, Angular) to backend data sources
    • Implemented comprehensive test automation that improved code quality and reduced regression bugs by 60%
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PL/SQL · AngularJS · React.js

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
Spearheaded SharePoint development for multiple clients
Integrated Azure AD and Microsoft Graph API
Architected, developed and implemented custom SharePoint solutions
Designed, developed, and marketed initial product offering for Canviz
Collaborated with offshore personnel for 24 hour development
Designed and built custom RWD SharePoint inter- and intra- net sites
Developed end-to-end custom SharePoint product using Azure and PayPal

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Deadline driven web expert

Created unique enterprise-level applications
Implemented web designs under tight deadlines
Developed complex ASP .NET web sites
Implemented IIS and SQL Server backend
Utilizing C# developed complex user and curriculum management applications
Developed pixel perfect web sites from PSDs
Integrated third party components for highly usable ecommerce web sites
Constructed optimized IIS and SQL Server backend for all projects

positions.title: Front end developer
positions.description:
Mobile and desktop usability expert

Developed iPhone and iPad web presence for major publishing company
Integrated with a full Linux, xml and database backend
Created Ruby on Rails UI optimizations
Built interactive Flash web applications for high-profile retailers
Created graphics for UI elements
Collaborated with designers, developers and program managers to complete projects
Utilized ActionScript 2.0 and 3.0 to create interactive web applications
Bounced between all aspects of Adobe CS4 to design and develop web graphics

positions.title: Web Designer/Developer/Technical Communications Expert
positions.description:
Designed, developed and resolutely maintained a large, high-traffic website:  
Hand designed the HTML, CSS and JavaScript for an internal Amdocs site.
Maintained cross-browser compatibility standards.  
Further honed Flash animation and ActionScript skills
Managed all html look and feel for product groups
Developed a good-looking and easy interface for users looking for specific information in a large pool.
Implemented code to preserve look and feel of Amdocs pages across browsers
Created proof-of-concept Flash animations displaying product flow through complex systems
Designed new external facing templates for html documents, emails and white papers

positions.title: Web Designer/Developer/Technical Writer
positions.description:
Deft web designer with development skills:
Ace xhtml and aspx web developer.
Adroit web designer with Flash and graphics skills
Managed user interface design with cross-team members
Designed newsletters and marketing and advertising materials for both print and the web
Regularly updated the Vorsite corporate website, creating new pages, graphics and content
Designed and developed icons, graphics and banner ads for the Vorsite website
Developed custom web page layouts and navigation for Vorsite customers
Designed the Vorsite InSite newsletter and various marketing and promotional material for online and trade shows
